newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X says report not material - TSE.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X says report not material - TSE.

text.p: The Toronto Stock Exchange and the Ontario Securities Commission said on Thursday that Bre-X Minerals Ltd had stated that a report from Kilborn SNC-Lavalin Inc on the Busang gold discovery did not contain any new material information.
The TSE and securities regulator said in a statement the engineering company's report on Bre-X Minerals' assay methods would be made available to the public today.
"Bre-X has stated that the report does not contain any new material information," the statement said.

Bre-X has been under pressure since last week when its partner in Indonesia, Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc., revealed that early drilling samples performed during its due diligence process on the Busang gold property in the rain forests of Borneo turned up "insignificant" amounts of gold and "visual differences" from Bre-X's gold samples.
The Kilborn report was expected to be released on Monday, but Bre-X chief executive officer David Walsh said on Tuesday the company needed more time to study the review.
